description: This Java interface defines a Spring Data JPA repository for managing UserCreatedShelf entities, including methods for retrieving shelves by user, name, ID, and checking for the existence of a shelf name.

classes.name: UserCreatedShelfRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for UserCreatedShelf entities, providing methods for common database operations and custom queries.

methods.name: findAllByUser
methods.description: Retrieves all UserCreatedShelf entities associated with a specific User, including their books via EntityGraph.

methods.name: findByShelfNameAndUser
methods.description: Finds a UserCreatedShelf by its name and associated User, including books.

methods.name: findByShelfName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of UserCreatedShelf entities matching the given shelf name, including books.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a UserCreatedShelf by its ID, including books.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all UserCreatedShelf entities, including books.

methods.name: shelfNameExists
methods.description: Checks if a shelf with a given name exists, case-insensitive and trimmed.
